_comment: Material removed from the studybible-mcp checkout before its build scripts run (scripts/prune.py). Reasons in SOURCES.md.

data_dirs.heiser: Michael S. Heiser: copies of in-copyright papers and podcast transcripts, entries summarising them with page ranges, and the textual-variant cases built on his arguments.
data_dirs.stott: John Stott (d. 2011): chapter-by-chapter summaries of in-copyright books.
data_dirs.lennox: John Lennox: summaries of in-copyright books.
data_dirs.bradley: Bradley, 'Two Fathers Only': summaries of an unpublished in-copyright paper.
data_dirs.synthesis: Atonement synthesis note: an argument built on the excluded Bradley paper and Rillera's Lamb of the Free, pointing readers to the excluded ANE entries.

ane_entry_ids._reason: Added by scripts/ingest_lamb_of_free.py and scripts/ingest_atonement_synthesis.py: summaries of Andrew Rillera, Lamb of the Free (Cascade, 2024), in copyright.

ane_entry_restore._reason: ingest_lamb_of_free.py also appended Lamb of the Free material to two kept entries (studybible-mcp commit ab08d12d); they are restored to their text at that commit's parent.
